text: だから　むし・ひこうタイプの　バタフリーは　４ぶんの１しか　ダメージを　うけなくて　すむんだ！

structure.jp: むし・ひこうタイプの　バタフリーは
４ぶんの１しか　ダメージを　うけなくて　すむんだ！
structure.en: gets by with taking only a quarter of the damage!

patterns.name: 〜なくてすむ
patterns.explanation: なくて すむ after a verb means you get by without having to do it. うけなくて すむ = 'gets away without taking (more)'.

patterns.name: 〜しか〜ない
patterns.span: ４ぶんの１しか　ダメージを　うけなくて
patterns.explanation: しか together with a 'not' verb means 'only, nothing more than'. ４ぶんの１しか ダメージを うけなくて = 'taking only a quarter of the damage'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end shows the speaker is explaining how things are. すむんだ = 'it gets off lightly, you see'.
